name: GitHub issue summary to webhook
description: When GitHub fires a webhook for a new issue, summarise the body in two sentences and POST the summary back to a downstream webhook (Make.com, n8n, Zapier, …).

config.prompt:
A GitHub `issues.opened` webhook just fired. The full payload is at {{trigger}}. Return a 2-sentence summary capturing:
- The issue title + which repo it landed in.
- The single most actionable detail from the body (bug repro, feature ask, blocker).

Return ONLY the summary text — no markdown, no headers.

rationale_at_seed: Webhook trigger — tunnel_uuid is a placeholder (zero-uuid). The catalog [Add] flow rebinds it to a freshly registered tunnel at seed time.
target_path `/github-issue` keeps the downstream URL legible in the user's webhook list.
Two-node chain stays under the 2 KiB JSON budget. The agent does prose; the http_request does the deterministic forward.
response_capture=status_only because downstream consumers care that the POST landed, not what they returned.
on_error=halt so a failed forward surfaces as a clear `Failed` run instead of a silent partial — webhook flows are typically integration glue and silent partials are the worst failure mode.
